Student leadership with professional guidance.

Meet the Team

MINDWAVE is structured around student initiative, peer support, creative education, and clinical advisory capacity.

Roles

A practical team model for a growing initiative.

Profiles are structured as role slots so MINDWAVE can add real names, photos, permissions, and bios when governance is ready.

S

Student Initiative Lead

Strategy, partnerships, and student mobilization

Builds the long-term operating rhythm and keeps the initiative student-owned.

P

Peer Support Coordinator

Safe spaces, referrals, and volunteer training

Designs peer check-in structures that are warm, ethical, and escalation-aware.

C

Clinical Advisor

Professional guidance and screening governance

Reviews referral pathways, risk handling, and mental health literacy accuracy.

C

Creative & Media Lead

Campaign storytelling, podcasts, and digital education

Turns evidence-informed messages into content students actually engage with.
